repo.description:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

In operator mode, account administrators issue signed user credentials containing subject permissions.

### Problem Description

A signed user credential containing a malformed permission subject could pass claim validation and later trigger a panic while the server installed its permissions. An administrator of a trusted account could cause denial of service beyond that account. Equivalent malformed permissions in configuration files were rejected.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.12.14, v2.14.4 and v2.15.0. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-h9r4-8j36-3c2f>
 * Credit: Taeyoung Jeong (@ttzero25)
repo.summary: Malformed JWT permission subjects can terminate the server
